name: Design Divider
description: Design Collection divider family: a section break or section heading in 8 distinct styles, from a hairline with a centered title to an eyebrow heading, a glowing gradient rule, an icon medallion, a pill label, an accent underline, a dotted scene break and a side label with a count. Follows the Universal Theme heading and separator pattern and takes every color from the active theme style.
helpText: Pick a Style. Title is optional: without it the divider is a pure separator (role separator); with it the divider is a section heading (h3). Eyebrow and Description are shown by Eyebrow Title, Accent Underline and Side Label. Meta, for example a count, is shown at the end of the row. Colors follow the active Universal Theme style.

attributes.name: Style
attributes.helpText: Divider design. Line Title: hairlines on both sides of the title. Eyebrow Title: small primary eyebrow over a large title and a rule below. Gradient Line: glowing primary gradient rule with an optional caption. Icon Center: icon medallion on the line, title read by screen readers only. Pill Label: title in a rounded chip on the line. Accent Underline: title over a hairline with a short thick primary segment. Dotted: dotted rule with a small caps title or a three-dot ornament. Side Label: icon and title at the start, rule to the end, Meta as a count chip.

attributes.name: Title
attributes.helpText: Optional section title, rendered as an h3. Leave empty for a plain separator.

attributes.name: Eyebrow
attributes.helpText: Optional short line above the title, for example Step 2 or Finance. Shown by Eyebrow Title, Accent Underline and Side Label; needs a Title.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.helpText: Optional sentence below the title. Shown by Eyebrow Title, Accent Underline and Side Label; needs a Title.

attributes.name: Icon
attributes.helpText: Optional Font APEX icon class, for example fa-calendar. Icon Center uses it as the medallion; without it a small diamond is shown.

attributes.name: Meta
attributes.helpText: Optional short text at the end of the row, for example 12 orders. Side Label shows it as a count chip.

attributes.name: Alignment
attributes.helpText: Where the title sits. Empty uses the style default: centered for Line Title, Gradient Line, Icon Center, Pill Label and Dotted; start for Eyebrow Title, Accent Underline and Side Label.

attributes.name: Spacing
attributes.helpText: Space above and below the divider.
